name: Tempester n°31: the two Real Time FX ribbons over MIDI, both ways (CC 108/109 position, 110/111 release, 112/113 pressure)
explanation: Dependency: requires n°9b (patch/nrpn_emission.json) for its SENDCC routine at 0x9d07a504. Why: the two Real Time FX ribbons (Panel messages 0x70-0x73, event signal 8: Note FX, Beat FX in 16 Beats, Latch, FX3/FX4 with Shift + Latch) could not be played or followed over MIDI. Physical path: [routine] ([address], main loop) calls [routine] / [routine] ([address] / [address]) when the raw byte turns non-zero / zero (byte +5 of the ribbon state [address] + ribbon * 0x110), stores the raw byte there, then [routine](ribbon, 0-127 from the System calibration, 0 released); messages 0x72/0x73 call [routine](ribbon, raw) ([address], keeps raw >> 1). Receive: CC 108/109 = ribbon 1/2 touched at position v (0-127), CC 110/111 = released (value ignored), CC 112/113 = pressure v (0-127), on the Remote Pad IN channel ([address], 0 = All), DIN and USB: the same calls as [routine] (touch/release only when byte +5 changes; byte +5 = 0x80 or 0), without the calibration (the raw bytes [address]/[address], read only by the calibration screen, and the never-read scaled copies [address]/[address] are left to the Panel); the CC is not published as event 10. Hook: the tail call of [routine] to [routine], reached with status 0xB0 only from [routine] (main loop, outside any UI dispatch); any other event goes on unchanged. Report: the tail call of [routine] to [routine] raises bit ribbon in [address]; the main loop, just before [routine] ([address], each Timer 3 tick), sends one pending ribbon per tick when Remote Pad OUT is not Off and the DIN send ring holds at most 16 bytes, through SENDCC (DIN then USB): CC 108 + ribbon = position when touched, CC 110 + ribbon = 0 when released (latest state, coalesced). Remote moves raise no bit (no echo). Pressure is received, not reported. RAM: [address] (high byte of a u16 of the stock DIN NRPN parser, unreachable since n°9a; used by no other patch). Code 0x9d07cc00-0x9d07cd4f, free flash.

edits.why: j 0x9d07cc00 ; [routine]: was "j [address]" ([routine]), made by RX; delay slot "sw v1,0x14(v0)" kept
j 0x9d07ccb8 ; [routine], messages 0x70 / 0x71: was "j [address]" ([routine]), made by TX; delay slot "addiu sp,sp,0x20" kept
jal 0x9d07ccd0 ; main loop: was "jal [address]" ([routine]), made by DRAIN as a tail call; delay slot "nop" kept
lbu t0,0x8(a1) ; Live: a0 = UI object, a1 = v0 = event [address] (filled), a2 = CC, a3 = value, ra = publisher's caller
bne t0,t1,0x9d07ccb0 ; not a CC: unchanged
addiu t2,a2,-0x6c ; delay slot: t2 = CC - 108
lbu t3,0x49eb(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad IN [address] (0 = All)
sltiu t1,t2,0x4 ; (also the delay slot above, harmless on the way out) 0 for CC 112 / 113 (pressure)
addu t3,t3,gp ; t3 = gp + ribbon * 0x110: byte +5 of the ribbon state ([address] + ribbon * 0x110) at t3 + 0x4c2d
movz t4,zero,t1 ; t4 = new byte +5: 0x80 touched, 0 released (its readers only test it against 0)
movz a3,zero,t1 ; released: position 0, as [routine] for a raw byte 0
lbu t5,0x4c2d(t3) ; byte +5 left by the previous message
sb t4,0x4c2d(t3) ; new byte +5, before the touch / release event (no reader there: [routine] is its only one)
beq t5,t1,0x9d07cca0 ; touch state unchanged: only the position, as [routine]
or a1,a3,zero ; delay slot: a1 = position
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; touch state changes: touch or release event first
jalr t9 ; (ribbon), as [routine] on a change of byte +5
j [address] ; [routine](ribbon, position), tail call back to [routine]: the CC is not published
j [address] ; [routine](ribbon, raw = v << 1), tail call, as messages 0x72 / 0x73: not published either
j [address] ; [routine](object, event): the replaced tail call
li t0,0x1 ; a0 = ribbon, a1 = position; main loop ([routine]), its frame already popped
j [address] ; [routine](ribbon, position), the replaced tail call
lbu t0,-0x7f7f(gp) ; Live: a0 = 1 ([routine] argument), ra = main loop
beq t0,zero,0x9d07cd48 ; nothing pending (every tick but a few)
lbu t1,0x49ec(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad OUT [address] (0 = Off)
beq t1,zero,0x9d07cd48 ; Off: nothing sent, the bits stay
delay slot: DIN send ring write index [address] | read index [address]
beq t2,zero,0x9d07cd48 ; more than 16 bytes waiting: a later tick
addiu a0,t1,-0x1 ; delay slot: a0 = channel 0-15
srl t1,t0,0x1 ; t1 = ribbon served: 1 when its bit 1 is pending, else 0 (then bit 0 is)
sb t0,-0x7f7f(gp) ; one message per tick, its bit cleared before sending (main loop only: nothing raises one meanwhile)
addu t4,t4,gp ; ribbon state at t4 + 0x4c28
addiu a1,t1,0x6c ; touched: CC 108 + ribbon = position
jal 0x9d07a504 ; SENDCC(channel, CC, value) of nrpn_emission: DIN B0|ch CC v, then USB
j [address] ; [routine](1): the replaced call, as a tail call (its v0 = message code goes back to main)
li a0,0x1 ; delay slot: the argument the main loop passes ([address], [address])
